title: More on Disjunctive Convex Hulls of Generalized Cross Polytopes
summary: We continue the study of the convex hull $D\subset\mathbb{R}^{d+n}$ of a disjunction of $n+1$ polytopes in $\mathbb{R}^d$, managed by $n$ binary indicator variables. Previously, $D$ had been characterized for arbitrary polytopes when $d\in\{1,2\}$, for polytopes sharing a common constraint matrix (under a technical condition, including hyper-rectangles), and for two generalized cross polytopes ($n=1$). Here we give a complete description of $D$ for arbitrary $n$ and $d$ when all $n+1$ polytopes are generalized cross polytopes. Every vertical facet is described by a normalized support…
